name: Amaba Hana
source:
A Fuuta's classmate and his childhood friends from before he entered kindergarten. At school, she does not speak with him much, yet, as her house is next door, every day she comes to greet him when he returns from school. An honor student who excels in both academics and sports. She has a calm personality.

[Translated from the [url=http://bellkage.blog.jp/yubikiri.html]official site[/url]]
